$comment: Public sign-up (server/fnHost/signup.ts, src/domain/signup.ts). Additive: one new schema, SignUp, read and written by the service identity only (the public /api/auth routes act as the service; no person reads these rows). PlatformSetting key auth.signup ("open" | "invite-only", default "open") is read with that default when absent. Apply expand-first BEFORE deploying the web app. Validations: validations.json; indexes: indexes.json; policies: policies.json and rules.json (service only).

fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: Always empty: only the service identity reads sign-up rows.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the server.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the server.

fields.name: UserId
fields.description: The IAM user created by the sign-up (inactive until the address is verified).

fields.name: OrganizationName
fields.description: Name of the first organization, created after the first sign-in.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Plan picked on the pricing page (?plan=), or empty.

fields.name: TokenHash
fields.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the current verification link's secret; empty once used. The secret itself is never stored.

fields.name: TokenExpiresAt
fields.description: ISO time the current verification link stops working (24 hours after it was sent).

fields.name: SentCount
fields.description: Verification e-mails sent for this sign-up.

fields.name: LastSentAt
fields.description: ISO time of the last verification e-mail.

fields.name: VerifiedAt
fields.description: ISO time the address was verified.

fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: The first organization, once created after the first sign-in.
